commands.name: runtime-controls
premodel-controls

limits: One new endpoint-paced 80.04s public Gen2 CPU process on the existing licensed AMI cyclic fixture. No physical microphone, GUI, new audio, quality test or default policy change. Match the saved independent C ABI normalized PCM hash, all 8004 rows/eight channels and all turns within the established 1e-6 bounds; report byte equality separately.

Model and runtime remain byte-identical to the previously qualified pooled CPU package. Freeze the saved independent 80.04s native reference before execution and deny it to the helper. This reuses prior neural evidence; it is neither a new native process nor a clean performance comparison.

Runtime/premodel denial and libc canonicalization controls precede execution. The version process requires 92 private images. A compiled helper premodel failure must persist complete:false with empty rows/checkpoints, return 1 and load zero private images. The one paced neural process requires all 92 images. Deny source/reference/provenance/prior-output data reads, protected input writes and network access.

Retain 4002 endpoint/readiness/admission/Busy rows, 15 or 16 consecutive provisional turn observations and final revision 17. Provisional revision 16 may coalesce before finish returns; never invent its observation time. Measure public finish drain/flush/delivery and caller observation. These do not isolate native queue/lookahead/publication delay or establish acoustic correct-label delay.

Paced public elapsed time includes deliberate capture-clock waits and is not compute RTF; report the native compute wall ratio separately. Scheduling, admission and native compute overlap and must not be summed. No stable-prefix/finality inference, intentional future sample delivery or post-hoc channel selection.

Keep the original 5GiB start floor, 1GiB running floor, 256MiB physical reserve, 600s command deadline, process-group termination and failure-stop behavior. The helper has a 180s soft session deadline; retain returned-error partial JSON. No automatic retry. All original quality, human word-gold, GUI/microphone, fresh-machine, signing and release gates remain open.

comparison.scope: wrapper/reference correctness at the recorded duration; not held-out quality or full release qualification

timing.scope: Endpoint-paced public API replay; timing components overlap and must not be summed.
